meta.depth_probe: 213 rows against a limit of 1000 and a floor of 200 monthly searches, so 213 is the true tail depth for these three Polish categories
meta.capture_policy: the response printed inline rather than persisting to disk, so this record keeps the derived counts and the decisive rows rather than a hand transcription of all 213.

verdict: ADMIT. Polish is the most open market measured after German: almost the entire tail sits at keyword difficulty 0.

derived.dominant_family: co zobaczyc w {place} and the near-identical co warto zobaczyc w {place}, which together carry most of the tail
derived.difficulty: the overwhelming majority of rows are KD 0 to 3. Only four rows exceeded KD 30 (co zobaczyc w londynie 45, muzea w gdansku 62, co zobaczyc w trojmiescie 42, co zobaczyc w bergamo 36).
derived.two_phrasings_one_page: co zobaczyc w warszawie 1,700 and co warto zobaczyc w warszawie 2,800 are the same question, and both usually carry the same parent topic (atrakcje warszawa). Also co mozna zobaczyc w warszawie 500. Three phrasings, one page.
derived.reading: the Polish tail is roughly half domestic and half foreign, which means this family feeds both the market axis and the destination axis from one dataset.

duration_axis_confirmation.finding: Polish independently carries the place x duration axis, which the German band probe surfaced and the English corrected probe sized. Three languages reaching it separately makes it a real axis rather than an artefact of one phrasing.
